title: Mara and the Orbit
author: Beatrix Brightwater
blurb: Jude Sterling, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
